manual_interim.protocol: Managed TCG and recycled cluster KVM run concurrently in one invocation at the same SHA. One run per target, test-result caching disabled, at most two Bazel attempts, target tracking disabled. Completed records observed at the cutoff form an interim convenience sample.

units: Seconds. Queue is enqueue to worker start, preparation is worker start to process start, process is native execution start to completion. Null marks unavailable or inverted clocks. The enqueue to final worker completion interval includes all native retries. A missing Bazel verdict remains missing even when the worker passed. Each pair ran both Claude and Codex.

post_cutover_devel.finding: The first post-cutover devel push reused a cached required KVM result. Its archive confirms the required KVM and managed shadow routes, and CI skipped launching the shadow. This push adds no fresh paired outcome.
